name: Isophote ellipse fitting
description: IRAF-ellipse style isophote fitting (photutils.isophote): per-galaxy radial profiles of intensity / surface brightness, ellipticity, PA, centre, A3/B3/A4/B4 (boxy/disky), growth curve; cmodel and residual images in new frames; honours the shared mask; profile table and plot window.

steps.label: Fit Isophotes
steps.title: Isophote ellipse fitting
steps.done_status: Isophote fitting complete (model and residual in new frames)

params.name: max-objects
params.label: Max. galaxies
params.help: Fit the N brightest catalog objects (by MAG_AUTO) when no NUMBER list is given.

params.name: numbers
params.label: NUMBER list
params.help: Comma list / ranges of catalog NUMBERs to fit (e.g. 3,7-9); empty = the brightest ones.

params.name: maxsma-scale
params.label: Max. SMA (x KRON*A)
params.help: Outer limit of the fit in units of KRON_RADIUS * A_IMAGE.

params.name: step
params.label: SMA step
params.help: Geometric step (fraction of SMA) between isophotes; linear step in pixels with 'Linear steps'.

params.name: linear
params.label: Linear steps
params.help: Use a linear (pixel) step instead of a geometric one.

params.name: fix-center
params.label: Fix centre
params.help: Keep the isophote centre at the catalog position.

params.name: no-harmonics
params.label: Model without harmonics
params.help: Build the model image from the elliptical isophotes only (no A3/B3/A4/B4 terms).

params.name: mask-neighbours
params.label: Mask neighbours (x A,B)
params.help: Mask the other catalog objects out to this multiple of their A_IMAGE/B_IMAGE (0 = off). The shared mask (Mask tab) is always used when it exists.

params.name: show-frames
params.label: Open model/residual in frames
params.help: Load the model (cmodel) and the residual image in new frames when the fit is done.
